mainEntity.name: How long does a window enlargement project usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for a window enlargement project can vary significantly based on the scope, structural complexity, and the need for permits. A straightforward enlargement might take a few days, while projects involving extensive structural changes or multiple windows can extend to several weeks. Our process includes a detailed project schedule outlining each phase, from permitting to final installation, so you have a clear understanding of the anticipated duration before work begins.
